spans.s: Vibudhādhipa, Vibudhādhipati (“lord of the gods”) = Indra, q.v.

Vibudhaśreshṭha^1 (“the best of the gods”) = Brahmán: XII, 6152 (Bº).--Do.^2 (do.) = Śiva: III, 9942 (Maheśvarāt). --Do.^3 (do.) = Indra: XIII, 3159.--Do.^4 (do.) = Sūrya: III, 16945.--Do.^5 (do.) = Vishṇu: XII, 13433 (Nārāyaṇaṃ Hariṃ), 13454.--Do.^6 (dual) = Brahmán and Śiva: XII, 13147.
Vibudhadvish, pl. (ºaḥ) (“enemy of the gods”) = Asura, pl.: III, 849; IX, 2712, 2951, 3519.
Vibudhaloka (“the world of the gods”) = Devaloka: XI, 556.
Vibudhārighna (“slayer of the enemies of the gods”) = Kṛshṇa: II, 1319.
Vibudhasattama (“the best of the gods”) = Skanda: IX, 2679.
Vibudheśvara^1 (“lord of the gods”) = Brahmán: XII, 9170.--Do.^2 (do.) = Śiva: III, 9942.--Do.^3 (do.) = Indra: III, 11899; XII, 1200.
